capabilities: Extract highlights from the current note into the clipboard as a bullet list
Create or remove == highlights with a hotkey on the sentence under the cursor
Customize the list heading, note title, footnotes and auto-capitalization
Turn highlights into Obsidian links to build an ad-hoc map of content
extras: The backlog describes a planned tutorial combining this plugin with the Highlights and Sliding Panes plugins for an 'explode mode' research workflow. The README also notes an Electron clipboard bug: when using the Command Palette, the user must briefly switch notes before pasting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to gather all highlighted text in a note into a reusable list with links back to the source.
summary: Copies ==, ** and <mark> highlights from the current note to the clipboard as a bullet list, and adds a hotkey to highlight or un-highlight sentences.
